coachDetails.headline: Strength & conditioning coach for busy professionals
coachDetails.bio:
I help people with full calendars get strong, move without pain and actually enjoy training. Every program starts with a movement assessment, then we build simple, progressive sessions around your schedule.

Before coaching full time I competed in powerlifting and worked with a Division I track team, so I care a lot about technique and smart progression.
